skills.name: Client object builder
skills.description: Build content blocks for the client_object.v1 envelope.
skills.instructions: Create content nodes that satisfy the shared client_object.v1 contract (one client object plus its provenance; the body inside it is governed by the client's own fetched contract).

skills.name: Article structuring
skills.description: Create a clear article outline and section flow.
skills.instructions: Transform the brief into a logical article structure with headings, key points, and artifacts.

skills.name: Artifact handling
skills.description: Track required and produced workflow artifacts.
skills.instructions: Validate artifact references, naming, and handoff readiness.

skills.name: Client contract intelligence
skills.description: Treat the target client's live object contract as the only source of truth for content shape, ids, media paths, taxonomy and publish gates. Works for any client a workflow encounters.
skills.instructions: Never shape client content from memory, from a workspace-local schema, or from another client's conventions. Fetch the target client's contract for the requested object type at runtime and obey what it returns.

skills.name: Editorial craft
skills.description: Client-neutral editorial craft for evidence-aware, reader-first, conversion-aware content: calm authority, practical specificity, low-pressure next steps, no hype. Voice and brand direction come from the target client's own record, never from this skill.
skills.instructions: Write for a smart reader who wants calm authority, not a lecture.

skills.name: Editorial review
skills.description: Review tone, clarity, grammar, and audience fit.
skills.instructions: Edit for readability, consistency, style, and brand-neutral editorial quality.

skills.name: Factual review
skills.description: Identify factual risks and unsupported claims.
skills.instructions: Check assertions, dates, names, and numbers; block when material claims lack support.

skills.name: Learning observation
skills.description: Capture reusable lessons from workflow outcomes.
skills.instructions: Record non-sensitive observations suitable for future workspace learning loops.

skills.name: Publication readiness
skills.description: Assess whether content is ready for dry-run handoff or publishing approval.
skills.instructions: Confirm criteria, risks, artifacts, and explicit dry-run/publish state before handoff.

skills.name: SEO review
skills.description: Review search intent, metadata, headings, and internal-link opportunities.
skills.instructions: Recommend SEO improvements without keyword stuffing or publication-specific assumptions.

skills.name: Source verification
skills.description: Check source credibility and citation sufficiency.
skills.instructions: Verify claims against authoritative sources and flag weak, stale, or unsupported references.

skills.name: Web research
skills.description: Gather current background information with citations.
skills.instructions: Research the brief, prefer primary sources, capture concise findings with source URLs.
